_comment: H-HEAT-002: Verifies that same-game old discussion (published >48 hours ago) is explicitly excluded from the current 48h heat window by filter_and_rank_candidates. The fixture includes a hot-discussion old candidate and a fresh candidate for the same game — only the fresh one should pass.
description: Two candidates for the same game event (Marathon reboot announcement). One is 72 hours old with high engagement that would otherwise score well; the other is 6 hours old with moderate engagement. The fixture validates that filter_and_rank_candidates rejects the old candidate with reject_reason='outside_time_window' and accepts only the fresh one.
